takeaways: Record water levels: potentially highest ever recorded for San Francisco Bay
Areas up to 3 feet above sea level threatened with inundation
Cause: king tides + extreme El Niño + global warming (not extreme rainfall/storms)
UC climatologist Daniel Swain corrected earlier official warnings about unprecedented rainfall

first-nations-community-rejects-suncor-p.title: First Nations Community Rejects Suncor Plan to Release Mining Wastewater into Drinking Water Source
first-nations-community-rejects-suncor-p.one_liner: Suncor proposed releasing treated tar sands mining wastewater into the Athabasca River, the primary drinking water source for Fort Chipewyan First Nations in Alberta. Chief Allan Adam rejected the plan, noting the treated wastewater is "deadly toxic." The federal government will make the final decision; this would be the first such release into the river.
takeaways: Wastewater source: Suncor tar sands operations
Destination: Athabasca River → Lake Athabasca (primary drinking water)
Suncor rationale: treated wastewater 'too corrosive' for refinery use
Alberta backs release without environmental impact assessment; federal Canada decides
Fort Chipewyan: 30% higher cancer rates; C$12M 10-year health study commencing September 2026

inception-extortion-gang-launches-large-.title: Inception Extortion Gang Launches Large-Scale SSO Credential Phishing Campaign
inception-extortion-gang-launches-large-.one_liner: Inception, a newly formed data extortion group, launched a large-scale vishing campaign targeting single sign-on (SSO) credentials across multiple global brands through phone-based social engineering. Okta and ReversingLabs have linked the group to coordinated attacks against corporate SSO infrastructure.
takeaways: Threat actor: Inception (newly formed extortion group)
Attack vector: vishing (voice phishing) targeting SSO credentials
Target: corporate employees; multiple global brands
Linked by: Okta and ReversingLabs
Focus: coordinated attacks on corporate SSO infrastructure

gpt-6-demonstrates-intrinsic-protein-des.title: GPT-6 demonstrates intrinsic protein-design capabilities
gpt-6-demonstrates-intrinsic-protein-des.one_liner: OpenAI released a preprint November 24 describing GPT-6's ability to design proteins without specialized biology models. In lab tests with Onava, GPT-6.2 designed proteins binding to five targets with 10.9% hit rate; redesigned sequences showed 50% median divergence from originals on some targets.
takeaways: 35 of 322 minibinders (10.9%) tested positive for binding across five targets
First experiment: IL-17A (18 hits), VEGF-A (8), PD-L1 (5), IL-7Rα (3), TrkA (1)
Redesign efficiency: MDM2 85% binding (75/88), VEGF-A 62% (26/42), PD-1 14% (8/59)
Median sequence divergence: 50% VEGF-A, 43% MDM2, 15% PD-1
GPT-6 matches/beats specialized tools on docking and motif scaffolding; lags on whole-structure prediction

nasal-drops-restore-memory-and-prevent-a.title: Nasal drops restore memory and prevent Alzheimer's progression in mice
nasal-drops-restore-memory-and-prevent-a.one_liner: University of Sydney researchers developed nasal drops using mRNA technology to restore memory and prevent Alzheimer's progression in mice. The drops stimulate brain-derived neurotrophic factor (BDNF) production, restoring youthful memory performance in aging mice and preventing cognitive decline in Alzheimer's-engineered models without removing plaques.
takeaways: Mechanism: mRNA in lipid nanoparticles stimulates BDNF production
Aging mice: memory restored to young-mouse performance levels
Alzheimer's mice: prevented severe cognitive decline
Novel approach: effective without plaque removal
Study published in Advanced Science; clinical trials in humans could begin soon

nasdaq-surges-6-in-best-day-since-april-.title: Nasdaq Surges 6% in Best Day Since April 2025 After Jensen Huang Returns to Nvidia Leadership
nasdaq-surges-6-in-best-day-since-april-.one_liner: The Nasdaq experienced a surge of 6% and the Dow rose 1,400 points, its best performance since April 2025, following Jensen Huang's return to Nvidia.
takeaways: Nvidia shares up 31.5% (+$950 billion) in single day
Largest one-day market gain in history
S&P 500 +4.7%; Nasdaq 100 +7%; Dow +1,450 points
Tech sector collectively gained ~$2.7 trillion

mit-researchers-show-primordial-black-ho.title: MIT Researchers Show Primordial Black Holes Could Destroy Stars from Within
mit-researchers-show-primordial-black-ho.one_liner: MIT researchers discovered that primordial black holes from the Big Bang could destroy stars from within. A black hole the size of an atom but with asteroid mass could sink toward a star's center and, if the star rotates rapidly, form a disk that produces jets punching through the star and causing visible explosion within seconds.
takeaways: Primordial black holes: atomic size, asteroid mass
Mechanism: gradual sinking toward star center; disk formation triggers jets
Result: intense blue/UV light, X-rays, gamma rays visible to current telescopes
Study published in The Astrophysical Journal; led by Ore Gottlieb (MIT)
Detection could reveal primordial black holes and explain dark matter

first-detection-of-dying-stars-final-nuc.title: First Detection of Dying Star's Final Nuclear Heartbeat
first-detection-of-dying-stars-final-nuc.one_liner: Astronomers detected a rare transitional phase in stellar death that may reshape understanding of the sun's eventual fate.

us-jury-finds-huawei-guilty-of-trade-sec.title: US Jury Finds Huawei Guilty of Trade Secret Theft
us-jury-finds-huawei-guilty-of-trade-sec.one_liner: A federal jury in New York found Huawei guilty of 10 of 12 criminal counts for stealing U.S. trade secrets from companies including T-Mobile, Cisco, and Motorola. The verdict concludes a years-long case originating from a 2018 DOJ indictment. Sentencing is scheduled for September 14, 2027.
takeaways: Guilty on 10 of 12 counts: money laundering, sanctions violation, bank fraud, wire fraud, conspiracy
Acquitted of racketeering conspiracy and obstruction of justice
Victims: T-Mobile, Cisco, Motorola
Sentencing September 14, 2027; penalties may include fines, forfeiture, restitution
Case originated from 2018 indictment; CFO Wanzhou Meng's fraud charges dismissed via deferred prosecution

cardiovascular-risk-detectable-decades-b.title: Cardiovascular Risk Detectable Decades Before Heart Attack or Stroke
cardiovascular-risk-detectable-decades-b.one_liner: Research from the University of Edinburgh examining over 100,000 people found cardiovascular risk detectable up to 30 years before heart attack or stroke. Systolic blood pressure was consistently higher—4 mmHg three decades prior, increasing to 7 mmHg closer to events—and biomarker changes were visible up to 10 years before symptoms.
takeaways: Study cohort: 100,000+ people (1985–2019) across US, Norway, UK
Cardiovascular risk detectable up to 30 years in advance
Systolic BP: 4 mmHg higher 3 decades before event, 7 mmHg closer to event
NT-proBNP biomarker changes detectable up to 10 years before events
Younger event-sufferers more likely to have diabetes and higher BMI in preceding decades

venezuela-reveals-2375-billion-debt-pile.title: Venezuela reveals $237.5 billion debt pile, initiates historic debt restructuring
venezuela-reveals-2375-billion-debt-pile.one_liner: Venezuela disclosed a total public and state debt exceeding $237.5 billion, equivalent to roughly twice its GDP, as the country begins a historic debt restructuring process.

belarus-leader-lukashenko-proposes-flyin.title: Belarus Leader Lukashenko Proposes Flying Zelensky to Moscow for Talks
belarus-leader-lukashenko-proposes-flyin.one_liner: Belarusian President Lukashenko offered on November 17 to fly Ukrainian President Zelensky to Moscow for direct talks with Putin, pledging to guarantee Zelensky's security. Zelensky rejected the proposal, countering that Lukashenko should bring Putin to Kyiv instead.
takeaways: Interview recorded November 17; publication scheduled November 25, 2026
Lukashenko proposed trilateral "Slavic" negotiations bypassing European involvement
Zelensky rejected proposal; counter-offered hosting Putin in Kyiv

president-of-the-united-states-prepares-.title: President of the United States Prepares New Targeted Tariffs
president-of-the-united-states-prepares-.one_liner: The president of the United States prepared targeted tariffs on 16 major trading partners following a Section 301 investigation launched in March 2026 into excess industrial capacity. Findings were expected as early as November 25–26, with China identified as the largest source of overcapacity in steel, aluminum, EVs, and solar products.
takeaways: Investigation targets 16 partners: China, EU, India, Japan, South Korea, Mexico, Vietnam, Taiwan, Thailand, Malaysia, Indonesia, Switzerland, Norway, Singapore, Bangladesh, Cambodia
Findings expected November 25-26, 2026
China: largest excess capacity; allegations of circumventing tariffs via Southeast Asian operations
Existing caps: 20% on Chinese products (second term); ~25% from first term
62% of poll respondents support tariff repeal efforts

putin-says-ukraine-hits-russian-oil-plan.title: Putin Says Ukraine Hits Russian Oil Plants Despite Trump's Requests
putin-says-ukraine-hits-russian-oil-plan.one_liner: Putin stated on November 24 that Ukraine continues striking Russian oil refineries despite requests from the president of the United States to cease, and promised retaliatory measures. Ukrainian drone attacks reduced Russian refinery capacity by 45% since late October, prompting regional fuel restrictions.
takeaways: Ukrainian attacks reduced combined refinery crude processing by 45% since late October
Putin promised 'inevitable retaliatory measures'
Several Russian regions imposed retail gasoline and diesel restrictions
Domestic fuel prices stabilized after peaking in October
Energy ceasefire declared mid-October; Ukrainian strikes resumed late October

back-to-back-measles-deaths-reported-us-.title: Back-to-Back Measles Deaths Reported; U.S. Tally Reaches 14
back-to-back-measles-deaths-reported-us-.one_liner: Wisconsin and Pennsylvania reported measles deaths within 24 hours on November 23–24, bringing the U.S. death toll to 14. The national case count neared 6,000 for 2026—the highest since 1991—across 47 states, with nearly 650 hospitalizations. The U.S. lost measles-elimination status last week as vaccination rates remain below the 95% threshold needed for community protection.
takeaways: 14 US deaths; Pennsylvania's 9th, Wisconsin's 3rd
~6,000 cases in 2026 (highest since 1991); 47 states affected; 650+ hospitalizations
Pennsylvania leads with 1,638 cases; Wisconsin reported 920 cases as of article date
MMR vaccination rate: 92.4% of US kindergartners (2025–2026); only 10 states at/above 95%
US lost measles-elimination status; virus now endemic
